about_the_game:
Escaping a dull daily routine in search of a new challenge, you set foot on a distant fantasy continent and establish your own shop that produces and sells macarons.

Create a process that produces products customers love and generate profits. Start with a simple factory, then use your earnings to expand and grow, designing optimized process to meet increasingly complex demand!

Convenient Process Design

With a dedicated editor for designing process, you can freely create your own process and easily design it using powerful convenience features.

-Using the editor UI, you can conveniently place conveyors that ingredients move along and the facility that process them.

-With simple clicks, you can select products to sell and manage the supply and adjustment of multiple resources.

-More than 250 product recipes are included, allowing you to check each production process.

-A wide range of convenience features for process design is provided (favorites, moving and copying through multi-selection, blueprints, undo/redo, and more).

Process Optimization

You are given the challenge of creating process that can mass-produce various products within limited space. With a variety of differentiated features designed to build efficient and versatile process, you can enjoy designing your factory in depth.

-Build an efficient process using the labeling system.

-Create versatile process configurations through the automatic supply system.

-Use the simulation feature to freely test the process you have designed.

-Choose from more than 10 types of facility exterior and over 20 types of site exterior to design your own factory to match your preferences.

Expansion and Growth

To accumulate greater wealth, you can take advantage of various content that allows you to expand and grow your business. Develop your process to meet increasingly complex demand, raise your tier, and become a role model across the continent.

-Expand your process by purchasing new site.

-Use process upgrades to reduce processing time and increase production output.

-Expand your shop or open new shops with different themes to attract more customers.

-Review proposals from the district or participate in votes to choose options that benefit your business.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Macaronpolis is a management and automation simulation game where you build your own efficient and versatile factory, mass-produce a wide variety of products, and generate profits. Start from the ground up on a new fantasy continent and grow into a factory owner with the highest tier!
